Name: Shikari
Author: SorenWolfe
Punchline: Build, share and call raid strategies without leaving the game.
Description:
Shikari gives your static an in-game strategy sheet. Draw the arena slide by slide, assign every mitigation and utility cooldown to a specific player at a specific point in the fight, and let the plugin shout the call at each player a few seconds before the boss cast lands.

• /raidplan opens the planner.
• Slide editor with arena presets, waymarks, AoE templates, tethers and freehand drawing, and a zoom for close work.
• Searchable spell picker backed by the game's own action list, filtered to each player's job.
• Timeline entries anchored to real boss casts, detected live, with occurrence counting; the plugin also learns your fight's timings across pulls and can warn before the cast bar.
• Calls on a screen overlay, in chat, as a toast, with a sound, or read out loud.
• A minimap-sized window during the pull showing the current slide, where the party actually is, and a gold marker on your own spot that settles once you reach it.
• Import a fight from FF Logs, or a whole plan from a raidplan.io link.
• Plans travel as a single share code you can paste into Discord.
